name: ShapeShift
tagline: Sculpt 3D scenes in the browser with your hands, assisted by AI.
problem: 3D modelling software has a steep learning curve and clunky controls.
solution: Hand tracking from a webcam selects, moves and edits objects in a browser 3D scene, with AI generation of models.
demo_moment: Team-described: pinch an object and reshape it with gestures.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Y Combinator: Unicorn Prize” among 261 submissions.
Won the startup-potential prize and opened a waitlist.

lessons: A waitlist signals intent to continue, which startup-potential judges look for.
